About BCS Mechanical

Commercial mechanical work that saves energy, runs right and keeps customers coming back.

BCS Mechanical is a commercial mechanical contractor based in Layton, Utah, and a division of Bill's Comfort Systems. We serve Northern Utah, Idaho and Wyoming.

We build long-term partnerships through maintenance agreements, responsive service and solutions that fit each facility.

  • One team, every trade

    HVAC, controls, sheet metal and plumbing are coordinated in-house, so projects move faster and service calls get solved the first time.

  • Competitive pricing

    Lean operations and long-standing vendor relationships let us price sharply without cutting corners.

  • Decades of experience

    Backed by Bill's Comfort Systems, we bring proven people and trusted relationships to every job.

Now servicing Wyoming

We're opening a union shop in Green River to take on service, maintenance and construction work across Wyoming. We're hiring local tradespeople through the union, so Wyoming work is done by Wyoming crews.
